qualification.details: Ph.D. in Physical Sciences with specialization in high-pressure studies. At least 5 years of post Ph.D experience in national or international laboratories related to high-pressure, high and low-temperature research. Proven expertise in Raman spectroscopy and synchrotron-based X-ray diffraction studies using diamond anvil cells (DACs). Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, and analyse high-pressure, high-temperature and low-temperature experiments in laboratory and large-scale facilities. Strong record of peer-reviewed publications in high-impact journals.

selection_process: Online Interview Technical Discussion Personal Interaction
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for JNCASR Research Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the JNCASR Research Associate position is 11th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Physical Sciences with a specialization in high-pressure studies to be eligible for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate position is 38 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the JNCASR Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address by the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Research Associate position at JNCASR.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview, Technical Discussion, and Personal Interaction.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: At least 5 years of post-Ph.D. experience in national or international laboratories related to high-pressure, high and low-temperature research is required, along with expertise in specific techniques.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
